name: Hugging Face
tagline: Hub for open models, datasets and Spaces
description: Hugging Face hosts open models, datasets and apps (Spaces), with a PRO account, Team and Enterprise plans plus pay-as-you-go compute and storage.
features: Free CPU Basic and ZeroGPU Spaces
strengths: Free tier for CPU Basic and ZeroGPU
Egress and CDN included at no extra cost
limitations: Compute is billed hourly and can be costly for large GPUs

free.details: Listed free options: CPU Basic (2 vCPU, 16 GB) and ZeroGPU (dynamic).

api.summary: Spaces: CPU Upgrade $0.03/hr, Nvidia T4 small $0.40/hr, A100 large $2.50/hr. Inference Endpoints start at $0.033/hr (GPU e.g. H100 1x $4.50/hr). Storage per TB per month: base $12 public / $18 private, with lower tiers at higher volumes.

pricing.regional: Currency shown only as '$'. Regional or tax note: not stated.
